# Lesson 1 — Introduction to Artificial Intelligence

## Opening (10 min) {#opening}
Greeting and warm-up from the previous module. Activation of prior knowledge
about AI applications in daily life.

## Trigger (5 min) {#trigger-1}
![AI systems](./assets/img-1.png)

Detonator questions: Which of these systems are intelligent? Why?

## Input: model dialogue (15 min) {#input-1}
<audio src="./assets/aud-1.mp3"></audio>

**Transcript:**

> ANA: What is artificial intelligence?
> BOB: It is the field that builds machines able to reason and learn.
> ANA: Like the assistant on my phone?
> BOB: Yes, that is machine learning in action.

## Exercise 1 — Fill in the gaps (10 min) {#exercise-1}
Complete with the correct term:

1. ______ is the AI subfield that learns from data.
2. ______ uses deep neural networks with many layers.
3. A ______ is a step-by-step procedure to solve a problem.

## Exercise 2 — Multiple choice (10 min) {#exercise-2}
Which of the following is an example of deep learning?

- [ ] A spell checker based on rules
- [x] An image recognition model trained on millions of photos
- [ ] A calculator

## Oral production (25 min) {#production-1}
In pairs, discuss and explain two AI applications you use at work or school,
using the vocabulary and the concept definitions.

## Closing (5 min) {#closing}
Recap of the definitions of AI, machine learning and deep learning.
Assignment of the asynchronous task.

## Asynchronous task (10 min) {#task-1}
Upload a short audio recording (1 minute) presenting three AI applications
from your everyday life to the platform.
